title: the-tester-publishes-a-sealed-exec
intention: The tester publishes one way to run a shell command under its instance seal and get back its exit, stdout and stderr, so another component can run a proof-bearing instrument sealed without reaching into tester code.
why: Codemother's verdict runs every chart criterion's instrument with bash -c and no seal (cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict/verdict.py run_instrument), and chart instruments are `python3 <proof> | ...` (e9a2's four were). So every PROVED runs the ticket's proofs against live ~/.cairn. The tester owns the instance seal but publishes no interface to run a command under it (its charter's public_interface is empty), so the verdict cannot ask for one without reaching into tester code (RULE 1). Parent: dda0e72b9c67.
traces_to: RULE 1 (a component talks to another only through its public interface; the tester declares none today); Law 8. Parent dda0e72b9c67.
how: Add `cairn test --exec '<command>' [--timeout N]` (and the callable behind it, declared in the tester charter's public_interface) that snapshots instance space, runs `bash -c <command>` inside the same bwrap instance seal run_proof uses (instance_bind_flags over a snapshot swap, CAIRN_TESTER_INSTANCE_SEALED=1, the run marked with CAIRN_TESTER_TEST_ID), passes stdout/stderr through unchanged and exits with the command's exit code; refuses loudly (exit 2) when bwrap is unavailable rather than running bare. Proof under cairn/devices/tester/proofs/, written red.
falsifier: Done when (1) `cairn test --exec 'echo $CAIRN_TESTER_INSTANCE_SEALED'` prints 1 and exits 0; (2) a command that writes a file under ~/.cairn inside --exec leaves the live file absent afterwards; (3) the command's exit code and stdout come back unchanged (exit 3 -> exit 3, a PASS line passes through); (4) with bwrap unavailable it exits 2 naming the seal, never runs bare; (5) the tester charter's public_interface names the entry. WRONG INTENT if run_proof's existing seal path cannot run a non-proof command without duplicating it, in which case the entry wraps run_proof and the falsifier stands.
watchme: none, because (cairn/devices/tester/cli.py) --exec is a synchronous call whose refusal prints to its caller, and its seal reds via component_color on drift
children: none, because one CLI flag plus the callable behind it
